entities.name: Locthwain
entities.description: The black-aligned court of the Realm on Eldraine, exemplifying the virtue of Persistence; its castle floats on clouds.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Plane on which the Realm and its knightly courts exist.

entities.name: Castle Locthwain
entities.description: Floating castle of Locthwain that can be moved at its Queen's whim; later converted into a Phyrexian fortress and crashed.

entities.name: Queen Ayara
entities.description: Ancient elf from the days of the Elven Kingdom who rules Locthwain; compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Cauldron of Eternity
entities.description: Lost cauldron that can return the dead to life if it deems them worthy; the court of Locthwain was established around it.

entities.name: Blacklance Paragons
entities.description: Knights of Locthwain who travel deep into the Wilds in search of the lost Cauldron.

entities.name: Order of Midnight
entities.description: Elite knights of Locthwain who fly on giant ravens.

entities.name: The Wilds
entities.description: Wild region of Eldraine into which the elves withdrew and where the Blacklances seek the Cauldron.

entities.name: Elven Lords
entities.description: Rulers who enslaved mankind until humans overthrew them.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Phyrexian invasion during which Locthwain's court was compleated.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: Figure whose love spell enchanted the court of Locthwain.

events.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords who enslaved them; the five knightly courts are created and Locthwain is established around the Cauldron of Eternity.
events.quote: mankind rose and overthrew the Elven Lords that had enslaved them, and the five knightly courts were created

events.summary: Locthwain's castle is forced aloft by the curse of losing the Cauldron of Eternity.
events.quote: Locthwain had been forced aloft long ago by the curse of having lost the embodiment of its precious virtue

events.summary: Ayara and most of the court of Locthwain are compleated and the castle becomes a Phyrexian fortress.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Ayara and most of the court of Locthwain were compleated .

events.summary: Rankle's love spell enchants the court and many fall to their deaths from the castle.
events.quote: many fell to their deaths from the castle

events.summary: Freed of Phyrexian control, the castle crashes to the ground.
events.quote: Without the Phyrexians controlling it, the castle crashed into the ground

relations.quote: The court is ruled by Queen Ayara
Blacklance Paragons and the Order of Midnight
The magnificent Castle Locthwain floats aloft on a vast billow of clouds
